name: Conversations
author: Brett
description: Two-field notes (entry: value) pulled out of every conversation with Brett: Claude Code chats, claude.ai exports and the transcribed session recordings. Plain rules turn his words into a short entry (the rule, mistake or decision) and a one-line value (what not to do, what to do instead); whole sessions are not stored unless switched on. Every rules brief carries only the entries that match its task. Local, no tokens; AI only behind its switch.
